title: [Feature Request] Support for Claude Max subscription use in OpenCode
body:
Today I was made aware of that I am no longer allowed to use OpenCode with my Claude Max subscription.

This is related to https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/pull/1783

I hope that Anthropic can reconsider this decision or improve Claude Code so that it meets or surpasses the experience of OpenCode.
author: ThorstenRhau

top_comments.author: co-l
top_comments.body:
What difference does it make to Anthropic if we're using their CLI or another CLI?

We're still paying Anthropic and still constrained by the usage limits.

From a business perspective, that makes very little sense to me. I'm missing the point.

top_comments.author: Yanwan93
top_comments.body: Same problem here – I can't use my Claude Max subscription because the official client has never worked properly (crashes on summarization).
